---
name: Remaining domain skill proposal
about: Propose a focused data, product, reliability, writing, creative, education, literacy, edge, or agent-meta skill
labels: enhancement
---

## Proposed skill

What is the proposed `user-<kebab-case>` directory and clean portable alias?

## User trigger

What request should activate this skill, and what should not activate it?

## Existing overlap

Which existing skills did you inspect? Should an existing skill be extended instead? Explain the boundary and handoff.

## Scope and workflow

Describe the intended purpose, workflow, verification, common errors, non-goals, and handoff. Include one representative input and expected output.

## Sources

List authoritative public sources, version/date checked, and any license or attribution requirements.

## Safety and privacy

Does the proposal involve security, external actions, personal data, regulated literacy, media rights, or physical systems? State authorization, safety, privacy, and professional-review boundaries.

## Host compatibility

If this is an adapter or integration for an agent host, state the host/version checked, discovery path, frontmatter behavior, permissions, test task, and rollback path. Prefer the canonical `SKILL.md` plus documented export over host-specific duplication.
